lavender-whisper.$description: Lavender Whisper — Primary CTA fill, accent card surfaces — soft pink-lavender that signals the one clickable thing on any page without ever shouting

forest-ink.$description: Forest Ink — Secondary brand surface — teal pill badges, inner dark-panel cards, secondary buttons against dark backgrounds

ember-glow.$description: Ember Glow — Live/active state accent — notification dots, active mic indicators, occasional badge highlights

vast-ink.$description: Vast Ink — Primary text, button borders, dark section/card backgrounds — the dominant near-black that defines every dark chamber

lumen-cream.$description: Lumen Cream — Dominant page canvas, card surfaces, button fills, light text on dark — warm off-white that reads as paper, not screen

lumen-stone.$description: Lumen Stone — Subtle borders, nav pill background, muted dividers — one shade darker than the cream canvas for low-contrast separation

fog.$description: Fog — Muted captions, helper text, and de-emphasized UI labels.

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Secondary button text and nav text — slightly lighter than Vast Ink for less critical text

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Badge borders on dark surfaces, light text on color, SVG icon strokes

eb-garamond.$description: Display and editorial headings — classical serif at regular weight, used at massive sizes (up to 120px) where weight 400 commands through scale alone. The 0.85–0.95 line-height at display sizes tightens lines into a single horizontal gesture. Subtitle: 'EB Garamond' (Google Fonts) or 'Cormorant Garamond' as alternative

figtree.$description: Body text, UI labels, navigation, buttons, badges — geometric sans at weight 400 as default body, 500–700 for emphasis. The 1.3 line-height across all sizes gives comfortable rhythm without excess leading. 16px is the workhorse size (freq=716).
